comment: Recovered chord transcriptions. Sources are the same measured references MASTER's production_dna carries (fantastic vol 2 / vol 1, Donuts, The Shining). These play as first-class progressions; no second copy of the data lives anywhere else.

transcription_sources: The Guardian, J Dilla: the Mozart of hip-hop (2011)
21st Century Funk: A Microtiming Analysis of the Beats of J Dilla (academia.edu 29812748)
provenance.note: Recovered 2026-11 from the surviving production_dna tables after the STUDIO/dilla tree was found untracked. Chord symbols keep the transcribers' spellings.
